effects.description:
When spawning: Acquire a defensive shield (durability: 10% of max HP).
While defensive shield is active, enemy attacks will reduce shield durability instead of HP, and it will inflict Stagger on the enemy who attacked you. (Excludes some attacks.)

effects.description:
Electrified Treasure Areas can unleash an area attack that deals a fixed percentage of damage (5% of the enemies' max HP, max 4 Consecutive Hits) with a chance to Shock (Very Short) for 1 second.
The Electrified transformation will disappear after you or an ally captures Treasure, after a certain amount of time passes, or after you are KO'd.
